---
title: Stereo
---

Render independent images for each eye to present spatial photos, videos, and stereoscopic media in WebXR.

### Desktop Controls (User Mode)

- **Switch Eye View:** Press <kbd>1</kbd> to inspect the left eye view, or <kbd>2</kbd> for the right eye view.
- **Move Camera:** Use <kbd>W</kbd>, <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>S</kbd>, <kbd>D</kbd> to move forward, left, backward, and right.
- **Elevate Camera:** Use <kbd>Q</kbd> and <kbd>E</kbd> to move down and up.
- **Rotate Camera:** Right-click and drag the mouse to look around.

### XR Controls

- **View in XR:** Experience true stereoscopic depth automatically rendered for each eye in the headset.
